review with the applicant.

Verification of Employment (VOE) Process
Purpose
To ensure compliance with DOT regulations and company standards, our company requires timely and
documented verification of employment (VOE) for all newly hired drivers. This document outlines the VOE process
and recordkeeping expectations.
VOE Procedure
1. Required Attempts
A minimum of three (3) attempts must be made within 30 days of the driver’s start date.
All attempts must be clearly documented using the VOE Attempt Log located on Page 2 of this document.
Completed logs, along with any supporting documentation, must be filed in the driver’s DQ file within the specific system.
2. Types of Contact Attempts
Use different methods of outreach for each attempt:
• Phone call
• Fax
• Email
• Online contact form
Attempt to obtain clarification on any terminations or accidents reported by previous employers.
3. Using ATS Provider Xchange
The primary method for submitting VOEs should be through the ATS Provider Xchange platform.
If a carrier is not listed, enter additional information such as:
- Fax number
- Email address
- Phone number
4. When No Response Is Received
If you receive no response after submitting a VOE:
• Search online for the previous employer’s contact number. Call and ask for the correct department or contact
to receive VOE requests. Record the name, phone number, and result of the conversation.
• If no phone number is found, use the employer’s 'Contact Us' form on their website. Take a screenshot of the
message before submission and save it for the record.
• If an email address is found, send an inquiry email asking where to submit the VOE. Save a copy of the sent
email and log the attempt.
• If a VOE request must be emailed, use the form found on Page 3. You will need to attach the driver’s prior
authorization letter found in ATS Provider under forms.
5. Documentation
Ensure all outreach attempts are logged using the VOE Attempt document on Page 3.
Maintain a copy of all communications (emails, faxes, screenshots) for compliance.
Submit completed logs to the DQ file for proper recordkeeping.

Contact Protocols
• □ Dispatch contact for time off, allocation, loading issues, late starts, spills, accidents, cross-drops, and
equipment issues (before 0600 and after 1800).
• □ Jessica contact for equipment, maneuvers, safety/compliance issues (0600-1800 call; after hours, text).
Pre-Trip Procedures
• □ Clock into Telematics System and CE Connect.
• □ Select the correct truck and trailer in both systems.
• □ Perform DVIR walk-around and inspect for DOT compliance issues (e.g., brakes, tires, lighting).
• □ Bang on the tanks to ensure they are empty.
• □ Ensure all paperwork is in the truck or trailer.
• □ Review DOT Inspection checklist with trainee.
• □ Call Dispatch with any concerns before leaving the yard.
Post-Trip Procedures
• □ Complete post-trip DVIR and walk-around.
• □ Report issues to Dispatch and Jessica.
• □ Log out of CE Connect and Telematics System.
CE Connect Training
• □ Understand how to select a truck and trailer (see image below).
• □ Know when to select: 'at rack', 'left rack', 'en route', 'at location', 'left location'.
• □ Review app notes and where to upload BO Ls and meter readings.
• □ Upload BEFORE and AFTER readings every time if available.
Loading Procedures
• □ No phone usage during loading.
• □ Bang on the tanks to ensure they are empty.
• □ Load diesel in the same compartment if possible.
• □ Label compartments and review CE Connect notes.
• □ Verify loading number matches BOL. Contact dispatch if not.
Pre-Unloading Instructions
• □ No phone usage during unloading prep.
• □ Verify store address with CE Connect before unloading. If any doubt, contact dispatch.
• □ Collect veeder tapes and inspect for water if the store is open.
• □ Place safety cones and connect vapor recovery.
• □ Place green cone on DSL drop if applicable.
• □ Cross-check BOL with compartment labels.
• □ Stick tanks and inspect for water using paste.
• □ Note stick readings to record in CE.
• □ Diesel must be dropped first
• □ Contact dispatch if there is any water present in the tank. Do not drop.
While Dropping
• □ No phone usage.
• □ Use CE to enter expected gallons, stick readings, and veeder values.
• □ Water inches should default to zero.
After Offloading
• □ Bang outside of trailer to confirm empty compartments.
• □ Use site glass and bucket check each compartment.
• □ Check PSI (must be> 60).
• □ Stick tanks for after readings.
• □ Record after stick readings in CE app.
• □ Retrieve After Veeder tape.
• □ Finalize load in CE and verify Over /Short field is clear.
• □ Upload clear pictures of BOL and veeder tapes.
Zero Tolerance Safety Items
• □ Seat belt use required while driving.
• □ No distracted driving or excessive speeding.
• □ No phone use while driving, loading, or unloading.
